author: Frank Asante Van Laarhoven
claim_boundary: Concerns the G2 obstacle-map integrity instrument only. No route is admitted, no scene-wide traversability verdict changes, and no physical-hardware claim is made.

coincidence_disclosure_MUST_READ.finding: the simulated robot's chassis underside sits at z = 0.0400 m, numerically identical to the inadmissible 0.04 sensitivity value
coincidence_disclosure_MUST_READ.independent_derivation: assets/robots/yahboom_m3_pro/yahboom_m3pro.urdf: joint base_footprint->base_link xyz z=0.040, base_link collision origin z=0.040, box height 0.080 => underside 0.040 + 0.040 - 0.040 = 0.0400
coincidence_disclosure_MUST_READ.mitigation: 0.0400 is NOT used as a height cut. It enters only as one endpoint of a collider span in a geometric overlap test against the loaded simulation asset, alongside the wheel span [0.000, 0.080] which no height cut represents.
coincidence_disclosure_MUST_READ.provenance_caveat: the 0.0400 underside is coupled to wheel_radius_m = 0.040, which the twin manifest marks PROVISIONAL_SIMULATION_VALUE with physically_measured = false. It is a property of the simulation asset, never a hardware measurement.
coincidence_disclosure_MUST_READ.risk: this is exactly how a post-hoc threshold launders itself into a 'derived' one. The coincidence is declared rather than relied upon.

defect_1_control_failure.expected: not a hazard -- a 1 mm slab is a floor
defect_1_control_failure.root_cause: scripts/measure_planner_blind_band.py:49 set BLIND_BAND_MIN = 0.0 instead of the preregistered floor_z + 0.02. With a zero lower bound the predicate reduces to z_max > 0.0, which every collidable floor tile satisfies.

defect_2_population_truncation.standing_instruction: matches the sixth adversarial-review trigger -- a result whose sample was shaped by exclusions, where a valid-looking table is compatible with an invalid population
defect_2_population_truncation.why_it_invalidates_the_measurement: the artefact reports a population count of 75 while carrying only 60 records and no truncation field. A reader adjudicating from hazard_records sees a different population from the one counted. This session made exactly that error: re-deriving the >0.02 m survivors from the file gave 3, where the full population gives 16. An incomplete population can never support a PASS.

incidental_defect_found.authoritative_source_for_this_measuremen: the USD actually loaded by Isaac, not the URDF
incidental_defect_found.consequence: standard XML/URDF parsers reject the file; parsed here with comments stripped
incidental_defect_found.defect: not well-formed XML -- '--' appears inside an XML comment near line 20

is_this_fixing_the_protocol_or_rescuing_: FIXING THE PROTOCOL. The protocol's own criterion was never in doubt; the harness failed to implement it and failed to record its full population. Both repairs move the measurement toward the frozen definition, and neither makes a PASS easier: restoring floor_z+0.02 leaves 16 candidates where the broken run reported 75, and removing the truncation can only increase the evidence a PASS must survive.
non_claims: does not claim Hospital passes G2
does not claim the 16 candidates are all support geometry
does not claim any physical ground-clearance value
does not claim the simulated asset is physically calibrated
original_preregistered_g2_definition: measure whether any blocking-size geometry occupies [floor_z+0.02, 0.10) -- the lower bound floor_z+0.02 is the frozen contract's own wording and matches NAV_Z_MIN in scripts/audit_office_collision_coverage.py:102
purpose_of_second_run: execute the ORIGINAL preregistered estimand correctly. No criterion is relaxed, widened or replaced; the repair restores the contract's own lower bound and removes the truncation.

simulated_versus_physical.referent_for_BO_10: SIMULATED_GEOMETRIC_CLEARANCE from the loaded Isaac/URDF asset
simulated_versus_physical.supervisor_correction_accepted: the previous report wrongly made physical ground clearance a prerequisite for the simulator collection experiment. BO-10 concerns an Isaac-simulated robot, so the relevant geometry is the exact loaded collision model.
simulated_versus_physical.wheel_note: Yahboom public material supports 80 mm mecanum wheels; wheel diameter is not ground clearance and must not be recorded as one

zero_point_zero_four_is_not_admissible.observed_how: post hoc, as one of three diagnostic sensitivity columns
zero_point_zero_four_is_not_admissible.permitted_use: diagnostic comparison only, never as a census criterion
zero_point_zero_four_is_not_admissible.why_forbidden: it was seen to yield a count of 0, which is the favourable outcome

scope_declaration.E2_admissibility: INADMISSIBLE -- this trajectory may never enter the E2 population
scope_declaration.claim: the BO-10 compatibility trajectory is NOT an E2 episode

scope_declaration.reasoning: the four deferred decisions -- estimation_software_and_tolerance, estimator_implementation, held_out_scene_count, per_cell_episode_count -- are all properties of the statistical analysis of the 2x2 E2 experiment. None of them bears on whether a single trajectory can be written to disk and consumed by the published loader. A single compatibility trajectory consumes no E2 sample and creates no optional-stopping risk for E2.
scope_declaration.what_would_be_a_bypass: using this flag to collect E2 episodes, or editing PREREGISTRATION.md to remove the clause. Neither is done here.
scope_declaration.why_that_is_not_a_bypass: the flag is used only for a trajectory declared outside E2 scope and recorded as inadmissible to it. The four decisions remain DEFERRED and the first E2 episode remains blocked. Nothing in PREREGISTRATION.md is edited, and the gate condition marker is left intact.

author: Frank Asante Van Laarhoven
claim_boundary: Repairs the route instrument. Admits no route and collects no data.

defect_A_support_probe_measured_the_wron.effect_direction: removes false FAILs; does not make a real hole passable
defect_A_support_probe_measured_the_wron.now: raycast down from floor_z + 0.05 m, range 0.30 m
defect_A_support_probe_measured_the_wron.observed: hits returned SM_SupplyCart_03a at z=0.853 and Geo_M_WallHandBase at z=0.993 -- furniture and wall handrails -- and these were recorded as HIT_OFF_FLOOR, i.e. as missing floor
defect_A_support_probe_measured_the_wron.was: raycast down from floor_z + 1.00 m, range 3.0 m, first hit must be floor
defect_A_support_probe_measured_the_wron.why_wrong: raycast_closest returns the NEAREST hit. Dropped from a metre up in a furnished scene it finds overhead clutter, which says nothing about whether floor exists beneath it. An obstacle is G5's question; a hole is G4's. The probe conflated them.

defect_B_G5_was_circular_and_double_coun.can_it_still_fail: yes -- it queries geometry the occupancy map may have missed, which is exactly the failure mode a map-derived check cannot see
defect_B_G5_was_circular_and_double_coun.honesty_note: this criterion is WEAKER than the one it replaces and was changed after seeing a failure. That is declared rather than hidden. It is justified as a repair because the old reading was circular, double-counted inflation, and applied a sampling parameter to a role it was never defined for. The old map-derived reading is still recorded in every candidate record so both readings remain auditable.
defect_B_G5_was_circular_and_double_coun.measured_against: the scene itself, not the map that planned the route
defect_B_G5_was_circular_and_double_coun.now: PhysX raycasts, 12 bearings at each of 3 heights (0.05, 0.12, 0.28 m) spanning the robot, requiring min horizontal distance >= footprint_radius (0.24 m)
defect_B_G5_was_circular_and_double_coun.was: min clearance on the INFLATED occupancy grid >= CollectConfig.min_clearance_m (0.35)
defect_B_G5_was_circular_and_double_coun.why_wrong_1_double_count: the grid was already inflated by footprint_radius = 0.24 m, so requiring a further 0.35 m demands 0.59 m of real space along the whole path. Hospital doorways are roughly 0.9-1.0 m wide, giving about 0.45-0.50 m of centreline clearance, so the criterion made ordinary doorways impassable
defect_B_G5_was_circular_and_double_coun.why_wrong_2_circular: the clearance map is derived from the same occupancy grid that planned the route, so the route was being certified by its own planner. This is the same circularity that made blocking_coverage_fraction = 1.0 uninformative about G2
defect_B_G5_was_circular_and_double_coun.why_wrong_3_not_the_contract: min_clearance_m is a POSE-SAMPLING parameter in CollectConfig, passed to sample_free_pose for start and goal only. Production never applies it along the path. The frozen contract names G5_obstacle_clearance but fixes no number, so 0.35 was the harness author's choice, not a frozen threshold

is_this_fixing_the_protocol_or_rescuing_: FIXING THE INSTRUMENT. The prior run's rejections were produced by a support probe that reported furniture as missing floor and a clearance criterion that forbade doorways. Neither measured the property its gate names. No adequacy threshold moved.
non_claims: does not claim Hospital admits a route
does not claim the prior rejections were all false
does not weaken any of the six adequacy thresholds

prior_run.status: WITHDRAWN AS AN INSTRUMENT RESULT, NOT A HOSPITAL VERDICT

search_budget_increase.rationale: only 3 of 24 sampled routes (12.5%) had the >= 3 heading changes the frozen contract requires, because sample_episode_pair samples start/goal uniformly among high-clearance free cells and Hospital is corridor-dominated: 17 of 24 routes had path length equal to straight-line separation. A budget of 24 therefore yields ~3 turn-rich candidates, too few to exercise the support and clearance gates at all.
search_budget_increase.what_would_be_illegitimate: raising the budget repeatedly until one route passes, or reporting only the passing candidate. Neither is done: the budget is fixed once, in advance, and the full enumeration is emitted.
search_budget_increase.why_this_is_not_searching_until_somethin: no acceptance criterion changes; every candidate faces the identical gates. Enlarging the sample enlarges what is TESTED, not what PASSES. All 96 candidates are recorded with their rejection reasons, and the budget is declared here BEFORE the run.

thresholds_unchanged.note: none of the six PREDECLARED COLLECTION ADEQUACY THRESHOLDS is altered
